# Seguimiento de uso de este venv por fclean.
import atexit
import fcntl
import os
import tempfile

def _record():
    site = os.path.dirname(__file__)
    stamp = os.path.join(site, "fclean_venv_usage_v1.pth")
    os.utime(stamp, follow_symlinks=False)
    pid = os.getpid()
    with open("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id", encoding="ascii") as stream:
        boot = stream.read().strip()
    fd, token = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".fclean-running-{boot}.{pid}.", dir=site)
    try:
        fcntl.lockf(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        os.write(fd, b"fclean-running-v2\n")
    except OSError:
        os.close(fd)
        # Keep an empty legacy marker if locking is unavailable.
        return
    def finished():
        if os.getpid() != pid:
            return
        try:
            os.utime(stamp, follow_symlinks=False)
        except OSError:
            pass
        try:
            os.unlink(token)
        except OSError:
            pass
        os.close(fd)
    atexit.register(finished)

def _try_record():
    try:
        _record()
    except OSError:
        pass

_try_record()
os.register_at_fork(after_in_child=_try_record)
